# Contributing to PhotoFrame

<!-- Generated by Auto (Composer) - 2026-05-26 -->
<!-- Model: Composer -->

## Branches

- **`main`** — Java 21, Spring Boot 3.x. Default for new features and day-to-day development.
- **`java11`** — Java 11, Spring Boot 2.7.18. Long-term support for Synology NAS (`/volume1/java/current`).

## Where to work

| Change | Branch |
|--------|--------|
| New features, refactors, dependency upgrades | `main` |
| Urgent fix needed on production NAS only | `java11` (or fix on `main` then cherry-pick) |
| Frontend-only bug (ES5 HTML/JS) | Usually `main`, then cherry-pick to `java11` if NAS needs it |

## Backporting fixes to NAS (`java11`)

Do **not** merge `main` into `java11` (Jakarta vs `javax`, Spring Boot 3 vs 2.7).

For a fix that applies to both:

```bash
git checkout java11
git cherry-pick <commit-sha-from-main>
# Resolve conflicts in pom.xml, servlet imports, etc.
git push origin java11
```

## Building deploy archives

```bash
# NAS (Java 11)
git checkout java11
./scripts/build-deploy-tar.sh
# → dist/photoframe-deploy-1.0.0-java11.tar.gz

# Modern hosts (Java 21)
git checkout main
./scripts/build-deploy-tar.sh
# → dist/photoframe-deploy-2.0.0.tar.gz
```

## Releases

- Tag NAS builds on `java11`: e.g. `v1.0.0-java11`
- Tag modern builds on `main`: e.g. `v2.0.0`
